ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white/yellow pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central lobes; large, contiguous irregular ochre-yellow patches localized in the medial and distal regions of both lobes; black pigment bordering the trailing edge and concentrated heavily at the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an internal pixel angle approximately measuring 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-peaks concentrated at distal tips (barnacle clusters); the primary trailing edge exhibits low-amplitude, irregular serrations with several distinct notches on the right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature along the trailing edge, terminating in slightly tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, high-contrast, roughly circular clusters of raised white/grey pixels (barnacle colonies) localized on the outer distal edges of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive ochre-yellow pigmentation patches (biofilm) across both lobes; small dark circular focal spots on the right lobe surface; distinct notches on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetric and dense distribution of yellow surface discoloration across the primary white ventral field.
